import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

subprocess.run(["go", "clean", "-modcache"], check=True)  # want:go-clean-cache
shutil.rmtree(os.environ["GOCACHE"])  # want:env-path-delete
cache = os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/x")
shutil.rmtree(cache)  # want:env-path-delete
subprocess.run(["rm", "-rf", cache])  # want:env-path-delete
subprocess.run(  # want:go-clean-cache
    ["go", "clean",
     "-cache"],
)
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
subprocess.run(["go", "env", "GOMODCACHE"])
under = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=os.environ.get("TMPDIR"))
shutil.rmtree(under)
tight=os.environ["GOCACHE"]
shutil.rmtree(tight)  # want:env-path-delete
fallback = os.environ.get("GOCACHE") or tempfile.mkdtemp()
shutil.rmtree(fallback)  # want:env-path-delete


def docstring_with_apostrophe_and_bracket():
    """Prose in a docstring.

    An apostrophe or bracket in prose (bazel.yml's `bazel` job
    does not continue the line or open a quote.
    """
    scratch = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    shutil.rmtree(scratch)
    shutil.rmtree(os.environ["HOME"])  # want:env-path-delete


SCRIPT = f"""#!/bin/sh
echo '(' it's text
"""
shutil.rmtree(os.getenv("GOMODCACHE"))  # want:env-path-delete
